title: BrowseSafe: Understanding and Preventing Prompt Injection Within AI Browser Agents
abstract: arXiv:2511.20597v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) agents into web browsers introduces security challenges that go beyond traditional web application threat models. Prior work has identified prompt injection as a new attack vector for web agents, yet the resulting impact within real-world environments remains insufficiently understood.   In this work, we examine the landscape of prompt injection attacks and synthesize a benchmark of attacks embedded in realistic HTML payloads. Our benchmark goes beyond prior work by emphasizing injections that can influence real-world actions rather than mere text outputs, and by presenting attack payloads with complexity and distractor frequency similar to what real-world agents encounter. We leverage this benchmark to conduct a comprehensive empirical evaluation of existing defenses, assessing their effectiveness across a suite of frontier AI models. translated_title: BrowseSafe：理解并防范AI浏览器代理中的提示注入攻击
translated_abstract: 摘要：将人工智能（AI）代理集成到网络浏览器中，引入了超越传统网络应用威胁模型的安全挑战。先前的研究已将提示注入确定为网络代理的一种新型攻击向量，但其在真实环境中的实际影响仍未得到充分理解。在本工作中，我们考察了提示注入攻击的现状，并综合构建了一个嵌入在逼真HTML负载中的攻击基准。我们的基准超越了先前工作，重点强调了能够影响真实世界行动而非仅仅是文本输出的注入，并呈现了具有与真实世界代理所遇到的复杂性和干扰频率相似的攻击负载。我们利用该基准对现有防御措施进行了全面的实证评估，评估了它们在一系列前沿AI模型中的有效性。我们提出了一种多层防御策略。
tldr: 本文提出了一个基于真实HTML负载的提示注入攻击基准，并系统评估了现有防御措施，进而提出了一种多层防御策略，以增强AI浏览器代理在真实环境中的安全性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a benchmark of prompt injection attacks embedded in realistic HTML payloads, systematically evaluates existing defenses, and proposes a multi-layered defense strategy to enhance the security of AI browser agents in real-world environments.
